summary: implement chat session resume — chat/[sessionId] should hydrate from GET /api/sessions/[id] and render the chat UI
description:
Live: after first message, chat/page.tsx calls router.replace('/chat/<id>'), which mounts the [sessionId] route — currently a stub returning 'Session ... — resume coming soon'. The streaming fetch keeps running in the unmounted component's closure, so the response is persisted server-side but never rendered. Visiting /chat/<id> directly (refresh, share, or click from /history) hits the same stub.

Done when:
1. Shared chat UI lifted into src/components/chat-view.tsx (current chat/page.tsx logic + JSX). Accepts optional initialSessionId and initialMessages props.
2. chat/page.tsx renders <ChatView /> with no initial state.
3. chat/[sessionId]/page.tsx fetches GET /api/sessions/[id], renders <ChatView initialSessionId initialMessages />. Loading/not-found/error states handled.
4. First-message URL update uses window.history.replaceState (NOT router.replace) so the component does not unmount mid-stream.
5. Tests: unit test for the [sessionId] page hydration path and a regression test that asserts mid-stream URL update doesn't lose the response.
6. /history click → /chat/<id> → renders the resumed chat (no more 'coming soon' stub).
